translations.web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
translations.bsb: The iniquities of a wicked man entrap him; the cords of his sin entangle him.
translations.kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
translations.asv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.
